question: ______ is related to hockey.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aga Khan Cup**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Aga Khan Cup is related to hockey**
 
• The** Agha Khan Cup is a prestigious hockey tournament in India that originated in Mumbai.** 
 
• It's **named after the Aga Khan, a prominent figure in the early 20th century.** 
 
• The **tournament has been instrumental in the development of hockey in India. **
 
• **The Aga Khan or his successor, Aga Khan IV, presents a new trophy each time the cup is won outright. **
 
• Ireland won the cup outright in 1977, 1978, and 1979. 
 
• Other trophies associated with hockey include: 
 
• Bombay Gold Cup,Beighton Cup, Dhyan Chand Trophy, Lady Ratan Tata Trophy, Nehru Trophy, Rangaswami Trophy, Scindia Trophy, World Cup, Masters Champions Trophy

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Thomas Cup**
 
• A trophy awarded to the winners of men's international badminton team competitions.
 
• The International Badminton Federation (IBF) manages the competitions, and Sir George Thomas donated the cup in 1939. 
 
• **Ranji Trophy**
 
• A trophy associated with cricket. 
 
• **Davis Cup**
 
• A trophy associated with men's tennis.
 
• The International Tennis Federation (ITF) organizes the annual competitions between teams from over 150 countries.
 
• The Davis Cup was originally called the International Lawn Tennis Trophy and was first played in 1900
